meta.product: GoalIQ SPL Fantasy Phase 0 — clean sheet % + model FDR
meta.team_strength_source: GoalIQ Dixon-Coles, SPL results (ESPN) ['2425', '2526'] — goals-based fit (decay=0.0035, bayes=2.0); no free per-match xG feed exists for the SPL
meta.cs_method: P(opponent scores 0) from the DC score matrix (tau corrected)
meta.fdr_method: Model based 1-5: 0.55*rank(1 - win%) + 0.45*rank(expected goals conceded), quintile bucket across every team fixture of the season
meta.att_fdr_method: Attack FDR 1-5: rank(own expected xG in the fixture) inverted (little xG of your own means a hard fixture), quintile bucket across every team fixture. 1 = easiest to attack against, 5 = hardest.
meta.caveat: Pre-season: 26/27 team strengths are last-season priors from a goals-based model (no xG data for the SPL), indicative only. Promoted sides without top-flight data use an empirical promoted baseline measured from last season's promoted trio. No manual context layer (unlike FPL Phase 1b).
meta.far_basis_label: Fixture difficulty only, based on today's ratings. Clean sheet % appears as each gameweek moves closer.
